evidence: Single-author synthetic text study; no human-reviewed release corpus, natural speech, competitor output or native insertion claim
selection: Evaluate calibration and dev before opening test generation. Freeze selected policy or an explicit no-selection result. Never retune on test.
releaseGates: Independent blind meaning/style/fluency/hallucination review under docs/research/rewrite-evaluation.md, minimum three raters and complete matched coverage
Consented natural speech and frozen real-ASR inputs, split by speaker/session/content family; unchanged good text and verbatim controls
Zero stale preview or commit under cancel/focus/mode/source invalidation, exactly-once commit, original retained
Actual native offline microphone-to-editor scenarios on each supported target OS, solo/concurrent ASR and cold/warm resource/timing strata
No harmful accepted cases in protected fact/number/negation/uncertainty/technical identifier controls; no new semantic regression versus baseline
Stop-to-final p95 under 1500 ms on the declared device/load stratum, inclusive of every final validation stage
